description: The quarantine (#762): the events the hub refused for good, kept on the station in a table of their own. quarantine(row, reason, error) moves a row the forwarder sent out of the outbox into it (the hub's answer listed it under `rejected`, or it was alone in a batch the hub answered 400 / 413 / 422). A page, its text, an alarm and a source_event the hub did not call malformed are critical: requeue_due() puts a copy at the end of the outbox (a new seq, carrying qid) after 600 s, 1800 s after the second refusal, then hourly, never while a copy waits; after 24 h or 8 refusals one is `stuck`. Every other one, and a malformed one, stays `held` and is never sent again. A source_event the feed has a newer snapshot of (source_latest) is dropped instead of sent again. released(qids): the hub took the copy, the row is gone; late(qid): an alarm taken too late to raise, kept as `late`. dismiss(kind) drops a type's stuck and late rows (Health's Dismiss), drop(id | null) one or all (a person), the copy on its way too; strip_audio(seq) leaves a clip off an event too large with it. summary() is what the status says: kinds, states, reasons and errors, never an event's data. The rows survive a restart, the counters are per run.
